editorial: When a night of reckless drinking unspools into a chase down neon‑kissed streets, you feel your anticipation shatter into fear. The film roots its erotic thriller in a claustrophobic cab, turning every stop into a chilling tableau of rising tension. A masterful use of sound turns each city horn into a ghostly whine, amplifying the sense of impending threat. You, who crave psychological thrillers that slam your senses while your mind scrambles, will find this relentless ride as unsettling as it is unforgettable.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
similarMovies: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
